nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the iPhone purchase receipt the user names, including the price paid and whether VAT was charged

nodes.name: ComputeClaimedDifference
nodes.role: compute the extra amount Apple claims, from the price paid, the stated VAT rate, and the stated fee

nodes.name: CheckVatBasis
nodes.role: determine from the receipt whether the price paid already included VAT

nodes.name: VerifyClaimWithApple
nodes.role: confirm through Apple's official support channels, not any phone number the caller gave, that a VAT shortfall exists and what the exact amount is

nodes.name: ReviewVerificationResult
nodes.role: decide whether the receipt and Apple's official confirmation both support paying a shortfall

nodes.name: HoldPayment
nodes.role: stop without paying and record why the claim could not be confirmed, such as a receipt showing VAT was included or no official confirmation from Apple

nodes.name: PayVerifiedDifference
nodes.role: pay Apple only the shortfall that was officially confirmed, using the payment method the user approves

nodes.name: ReportToUser
nodes.role: tell the user whether payment was made or held, and why
